subject: Operational playbook and rev-share for OTLP -> Datadog/Grafana connector
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Nguyen <jessica@datadog.com>, Peter Holm <peter@grafana.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Operational playbook and rev-share for OTLP -> Datadog/Grafana connector

Hi Jessica / Peter —

Thanks for taking the time to explore the connector build with us. The engineering teams are aligned on a lightweight adapter that forwards OTLP traces/metrics into both Datadog and Grafana Cloud ingestion endpoints with minimal schema changes. Before we finalize the SOW, we need to lock two operational items so we can present a single commercial package to customers:

1) Rev-share & billing path: marketplace listing (partner-managed) vs direct billing through Redwood. We have a draft rev-share model in the attached SOW but want partner input.
2) Support & escalation model: who owns P1s, how cross-account debug access is granted, and an agreed RTO/RPO for joint customers. I've attached a proposed escalation matrix (xlsx) — please review.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick 30-min alignment call to pick billing path and preliminary rev-share percent (we can lock legal terms later).
- Sign off on the attached SOW v2 for a pilot customer (SignalWorks) so professional services scheduling can begin.

CCing Ben and Laura from our partnerships/ops team to help map the commercial flow. If you prefer, ObservOps (cc'd) can run a short runbook workshop next week and produce the joint playbook.

Available slots: Tue/Nov 2 10:00-11:30 PST, Wed/Nov 3 14:00-15:00 PST. Let me know what works and any immediate redlines on the SOW.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SOW-draft-v2.pdf, support-escalation-matrix.xlsx
From: Jessica Nguyen <jessica@datadog.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Peter Holm <peter@grafana.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operational playbook and rev-share for OTLP -> Datadog/Grafana connector

Mina —

Appreciate the clear summary. Datadog is interested in a joint listing, but two quick clarifications from our side:

- Billing: marketplace listing is preferred for smaller customers (simpler procurement), but for enterprise pilots we usually do direct billing (we can accept partner-managed invoicing). Which customers are we targeting for the pilot (size/ARR)?
- Support: we need a defined handoff window for incidents that affect ingestion (we typically require a 30-minute acknowledgement for P1s from the partner plus a shared console with request tracing). The matrix looks good; can you add a line for cross-account log sampling to help debug ingestion mismatches?

We can take Wed/Nov 3 14:00 PST. I'll bring our commercial lead and a support engineer.

—Jessica
Jessica Nguyen
Sr. Partner Manager, Integrations | Datadog
jessica@datadog.com

On 2026-11-01 09:12, Mina Haddad wrote:
> Thanks for taking the time to explore the connector build with us. The engineering teams are aligned ...
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Nguyen <jessica@datadog.com>, Peter Holm <peter@grafana.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operational playbook and rev-share for OTLP -> Datadog/Grafana connector

Thanks Jessica — and good call on the sampling line item. A few operational options for the meeting so we can have concrete asks:

A) Marketplace-first: we list an official connector SKU in both Datadog/Grafana marketplaces. Rev-share split proposed: 70/30 to the partner that handles billing and first-line support (70 to Redwood; 30 split between Datadog/Grafana depending on which ingestion path is used). Pros: faster procurement for SMB. Cons: longer payout windows and limited enterprise discounts.

B) Direct enterprise billing: Redwood invoices, we pocket the margin and remit a partner fee monthly. Pros: cleaner enterprise economics, faster PS scheduling. Cons: requires legal addendum for terms and revenue reporting.

For support and incident handoff: propose a shared Slack channel + a PagerDuty escalation for P1 with a 30-minute ack SLA and a 4-hour remediation/update cadence. We will add cross-account sampling and a debug token workflow in the escalation matrix.

Please review; I'll bring option A vs B comparison slide to Wed's call.

-ben
Ben Carter
Head of Field Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

> On 2026-11-01 11:03, Jessica Nguyen wrote:

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Nguyen <jessica@datadog.com>, Peter Holm <peter@grafana.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Operational playbook and rev-share for OTLP -> Datadog/Grafana connector

Perfect — locking Wed/Nov 3 14:00 PST for the alignment call (calendar invite sent).

Before the call we've taken the liberty of:
- Updating SOW-draft-v2.pdf to call out SignalWorks as the pilot customer and a tentative 65/35 rev-share (65% to Redwood, 35% to partners collectively) for marketplace purchases; enterprise-direct terms will be discussed as an exception path.
- Adding a cross-account sampling row to support-escalation-matrix.xlsx and a short debug-token process that allows temporary, auditable read-only access for ingestion traces.

Agenda for Wed (30 mins):
1) Confirm billing path for pilot (marketplace vs direct).
2) Confirm rev-share band and signoff to start PS scheduling.
3) Agree on P1/P2 handoff timings and the debug-token operation flow.
4) Next steps: legal contact exchange and draft marketplace listing copy.

If there are any hard veto items on the rev-share number or the support flow, please surface them before the meeting so we can prepare alternatives. Looking forward to making the connector broadly available — this should unlock a handful of mid-market customers quickly.

Thanks,
Mina
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOW-draft-v2.pdf, support-escalation-matrix.xlsx
